description: We are a team of students who are looking forward to learn and have fun.
summary: SATERA is a website that allow us to study and compare different landing places in the moon, comparing its sunlight and earth communication conditions. Our website includes a small map that can be seen and explored in 3d, and shows how this conditions are affected during a predefined time period.
details:
Our project gathers information from different locations to analize how efficient it will be for a landing, considering how much sunlight and earth communication is avialable in that specific poin. We do it with three different spots at the same time, so that we can make a more efficient and dinamic comparission between this places.

It works with the help of a small satelite, that can work with a radiofrequency or optically, depending on which one adjusts better with the conditions.
